title: 第119章 离合悲欢，缘尽戏终
slug: 给你尊荣你不要来世我去娶郡主
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

崇圣二十年。

裴文彧蹲在库房角落，翻箱倒柜，寻觅旧物。

是母亲王芷命他来寻一只尘封多年的暖手炉。

炉子寻着了。

裴文彧疾步奔回书房，含笑扬声：

“爹，娘，可是此物？”

王芷微微颔首，称赞道：“文彧乖。”

裴文彧拿起手炉，正欲把玩。

“哎哎哎，别耍那个。那是你娘崇圣五年弄的好物件。”

裴文彧听后，忽而一问：“爹，你怎么知道这是崇圣五年？”

裴璋眉间一扬，神色俨然有一分得意：

“文彧儿，这你便是不懂你爹了。你娘是天下第一心灵手巧，而你爹嘛，便是天下第一……”

“神机妙算。”裴文彧抢白道。

这话，他爹自吹自擂了多少年，他早已倒背如流。

当然，他有时候“闯祸”想要掩藏，却被他爹一眼看破。

说他爹神机妙算，倒也不算错。

裴文彧再问：“爹，那娘这些年来所制的每一只香囊的时日，爹可都记得？”

裴璋点头：“自然。”

裴文彧不信。

王芷也来了兴致，吩咐丫鬟去房内取，将半生所制香囊尽数拿来。

一枚一枚，列于案上，琳琅满目，宛如花开满桌。

裴璋信手拈来，一一数着：

“这个，崇圣三年，我突发奇想想要个螳螂，你第一次绣不太会，绣歪了，最后改线绣成兰草。”

“这个，崇圣五年，我升刑部员外郎，你为我所制。”

“这个是崇圣九年，我要去蜀地查案，你去求了平安符放在其中，连夜为我赶制。”

裴璋拿起一个绣着老虎的，看向儿子：“至于这个，文彧儿应该有印象吧？”

裴文彧看到那老虎，脸老红了。

他可太认识这个了，这是娘为他绣的。

他小时候，一直想“吃”了这香囊来着。

一枚一枚，如数家珍，如诉旧年。

王芷端坐一旁，静静听着，眸中泪光流转，唇角渐渐弯起，心中甚是欢喜。

这个浪荡儿啊，她这一辈子，真是没有选错。

裴文彧听完后挠挠头，居然生出一丝紧张来：“爹，我以后是不是也要如你这般，记得我娘子绣的全部香囊才行啊。”

裴璋告诉孩子：“哈哈哈哈，不错文彧儿，你以后，也会遇到这种女儿家的。一个让你不惜一切，也要娶回家的人。不过比你娘还要好的女儿家，这天下怕是没有了。”

Page (1/3)

Chongsheng for twenty years.

Pei Wenyu squatted in the corner of the warehouse, rummaging through boxes and cabinets, looking for old things.

It was his mother Wang Zhi who ordered him to find a hand warmer that had been dusty for many years.

The stove was found.

Pei Wenyu hurried back to the study and shouted with a smile:

"Dad, Mom, is this the thing?"

Wang Zhi nodded slightly and praised: "Wen Yu is good."

Pei Wenyu picked up the hand stove and was about to play with it.

"Hey, hey, don't play with that. That is a good thing that your mother Chongsheng got in the fifth year."

After hearing this, Pei Wenyu suddenly asked: "Dad, how do you know this is the fifth year of Chongsheng?"

Pei Zhang raised his eyebrows and looked proud:

"Wen Yu'er, you just don't understand your father. Your mother is the best in the world in dexterity, and your father is the best in the world..."

"A wonderful plan." Pei Wenyu said quickly.

His father had been boasting about this for so many years, and he had already known it by heart.

Of course, he sometimes "gets into trouble" and wants to hide it, but his father sees through it at a glance.

It's not wrong to say that his father has a clever plan.

Pei Wenyu asked again: "Dad, does dad remember the date of every sachet that my mother has made over the years?"

Pei Zhang nodded: "Of course."

Pei Wenyu didn't believe it.

Wang Zhi also became interested and asked the maid to go to the room to get all the sachets he had made during his lifetime.

One by one, they are listed on the table, dazzling like flowers blooming all over the table.

Pei Zhang picked them up at random and counted them one by one:

"Well, in the third year of Chongsheng's reign, I suddenly wanted to make a mantis. You were not very good at embroidering it for the first time, and it was crooked. In the end, you changed the thread to embroider it with orchid grass."

"This, in the fifth year of Chongsheng's reign, I was promoted to a member of the Ministry of Punishment, Wailang, and you were under my control."

"This is the ninth year of Chongsheng. I am going to Sichuan to investigate the case. You went to ask for the peace talisman and put it in it. You made it for me overnight."

Pei Zhang picked up one embroidered with a tiger and looked at his son: "As for this, Wen Yu'er should have an impression, right?"

Pei Wenyu's face turned red when he saw the tiger.

He knows this very well, his mother embroidered it for him.

When he was a child, he always wanted to "eat" this sachet.

One by one, they are like family treasures, and they are like telling the story of old years.

Wang Zhiduan sat aside and listened quietly, with tears in his eyes, the corners of his lips gradually curved, and he was very happy in his heart.

This prodigal, she really made no wrong choices in her life.

After hearing this, Pei Wenyu scratched his head and actually felt a little nervous: "Dad, do I have to be like you in the future and remember all the sachets embroidered by my wife?"

Pei Zhang told the child: "Hahahaha, yes Wen Yu'er, you will also meet a daughter's family like this in the future. A daughter who makes you want to marry home at all costs. But there is no daughter's family better than your mother in this world."
